info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Status API provides a comprehensive overview of the statuses of support tickets within the system. This endpoint allows users to retrieve current statuses, enabling teams to monitor issues effectively and improve response times. Typical consumers of this API include support agents, team leads, and integration systems that need to track ticket progress or perform analytics on ticket status trends. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance the efficiency of their customer support operations.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of tickets.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of their tickets. It provides valuable information regarding the progression and state of the tickets in the system, facilitating better tracking and management of customer inquiries.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve the status of tickets.

ListSupportTicketsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body content type for the GET operation related to ticket statuses. It is expected to be a plain string.
